entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: Pre-advice; matched on "electronically".

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde vom Absender elektronisch angekündigt.
entries.note: German pre-advice; matched on "elektronisch".

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde elektronisch angekündigt. Sobald die Sendung von uns bearbeitet wurde, erhalten Sie weitere Informationen.
entries.note: Pre-advice. Seen after a processing scan; dated after a scan that moved the parcel, it is left out of the history.

entries.wording: Für diese Sendung wurde ein Liefertag als Empfangsoption vorgemerkt.
entries.note: The recipient booked a delivery day; deliberately not mapped and left out of the history, like Hermes Germany's booked day, so it is not read as transit.

entries.wording: The preferred day delivery on <date> was ordered by Recipient..
entries.note: The English line for the booked delivery day; deliberately not mapped and left out of the history like the German one. Its day is the expected delivery while DHL gives no window.

entries.wording: A preferred location was designated as a reception option for this shipment.
entries.note: The English line for a place the recipient booked as the receiving option; deliberately not mapped and left out of the history like the booked day, so it is not read as transit.

entries.wording: Die Paketumleitung wurde aufgrund Produkt/Service- Kombination nicht erlaubt storniert. Die Sendung wird an die Hausadresse zugestellt.
entries.note: A redirect DHL refused, the parcel going to the home address; deliberately not mapped: a notice that keeps the stage of the scan before it, not a delivery attempt.

entries.wording: Sendung auf dem Weg zur Packstation.
entries.note: A Packstation as the delivery address, written beside the loading onto the delivery vehicle or on a redirect to a Packstation; deliberately not mapped: a notice that keeps the stage of the scan before it. Read as transit, it undid an out-for-delivery scan.

entries.wording: Abholung aus Packstation
entries.note: The recipient took the parcel out of the Packstation, with DHL's delivered flag.

entries.wording: The recipient could not be found at the address on the shipment.
entries.note: The courier's reason for a failed round.

entries.wording: Unfortunately delivery of the shipment was not possible. The shipment is returned to the sender.
entries.note: The round failed and the return starts; DHL heads it "Delivery not possible". The moves after it carry the parcel back.

entries.wording: Pick-up has been scheduled for the next working day and the information has been sent to the delivery person
entries.note: A booked collection, before "Pick-up was successful.".

entries.wording: Pick-up was successful.
The shipment has been posted by the sender at the retail outlet
entries.note: Deutsche Post's posting at a retail outlet, "in der Filiale eingeliefert" in German.

entries.wording: The shipment was handed over to DHL.
Die Sendung wurde im Briefzentrum bearbeitet.
entries.note: Mail-centre processing scan.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center
The shipment will be transported to the destination country/destination area and, from there, handed over to the delivery organization.
entries.note: Explicitly transit, never the handover it announces.

entries.wording: The shipment has arrived in the destination country/destination area.
entries.note: Carries the destination operator's link; an exact post.ch host marks a Swiss Post last mile.

entries.wording: The shipment is being processed by customs
The customs clearance process for import into the destination country/region has been completed.
entries.note: Completion leaves customs; the started variant stays in customs.

entries.wording: The shipment has been loaded into the delivery vehicle
Die Sendung wurde in das Zustellfahrzeug geladen.
The shipment is ready for collection
Die Sendung liegt zur Abholung bereit.
The shipment has been delivered
Die Sendung wurde erfolgreich zugestellt.
entries.note: The negated form maps to failed_attempt, not delivery.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde am <day> ausgeliefert.
entries.note: A day-dated history's delivery; the negated form is not a delivery.

entries.wording: Die Sendung befindet sich in der Zustellung.
entries.note: The round before a day-dated history's delivery.

entries.wording: The shipment could not be delivered
Ihre Sendung konnte heute leider wegen unerwarteter Umstände wie z.B. Krankheit, Unfall, Arbeitszeitüberschreitung nicht zugestellt werden. Ein neuer Zustellversuch erfolgt am nächsten Werktag.
entries.note: After the loading onto the delivery vehicle, the round did not reach the parcel for DHL's own reasons: a delay, not an attempt at the door. A new round follows the next working day.

entries.wording: Your shipment could unfortunately not be delivered today due to unexpected circumstances such as illness, accident, or overtime. A new delivery attempt will be made on the next business day.
entries.note: The English of the same delay.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde leider fehlgeleitet. Gegebenenfalls verzögert sich dadurch die Zustellung.
entries.note: Sorted to the wrong place; DHL readdresses it and sends it on, so the delivery may be late: a delay, no attempt at the door.

entries.wording: The shipment was misrouted and could not be delivered. The shipment will be readdressed and forwarded to the recipient.
entries.note: The English of the same scan, which no delivery attempt preceded.

entries.wording: Die Sendung konnte nicht zugestellt werden.
Die Sendung wurde nicht erfolgreich zugestellt.
entries.note: Negation is matched before the delivery wording.

entries.wording: Delivery not possible. Pickup information will follow by mail
entries.note: After the loading onto the delivery vehicle, before the parcel is ready at a retail outlet; CTT's copy of the scan is its failed delivery.

entries.wording: Delivery not possible. Forwarding in postal retail outlet
entries.note: After the loading onto the delivery vehicle, before the parcel is ready at a retail outlet; PostNord's copy of the scan is its DELIVERY_IMPOSSIBLE.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde abgeholt.
entries.note: "Pick-up was successful." in English.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde von DHL abgeholt.
entries.note: "The shipment was picked up by DHL." in English.

entries.wording: Die Sendung ist im Zielland/Zielgebiet eingetroffen.
entries.note: The arrival abroad, with the partner's link as in English.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wird für die Verladung ins Zustellfahrzeug vorbereitet.
entries.note: "The shipment has been processed in the delivery base." in English: not yet on the vehicle.

entries.wording: Available for pickup shortly
entries.note: After "Forwarding to outlet": the parcel is on its way to the outlet, not ready there yet.

entries.wording: In Kürze in Filiale abholbereit
entries.note: The German of "Available for pickup shortly", after "Weiterleitung an Filiale": on its way to the outlet, whose own scan ("Sendung liegt in der Filiale zur Abholung bereit") follows. A parcel left on it is discussed on https://www.mydealz.de/diskussion/dhl-in-kurze-abholbereit-2816465.

entries.wording: Ready for pickup next business day
entries.note: After a failed round, on the way to the retail outlet: a pickup forecast, not the outlet's own notice ("The shipment is available for pick-up from the retail outlet as of now."), which follows when the parcel is there.

entries.wording: Die Sendung liegt zur Abholung in einem ParcelShop/in der Postfiliale bereit.
entries.note: A parcel waiting abroad; DHL appends where to read more.

entries.wording: The shipment is returning to sender
entries.note: A return under way: the parcel goes back to the sender.

entries.wording: The recipient has not picked up the shipment from the retail outlet within the seven-day storage period
entries.note: Quoted on https://www.paketda.de/status-dhl-lagerfrist-nicht-abgeholt.html; the parcel goes back to the sender. "Not picked up" is never a pick-up.

entries.wording: Der Empfänger hat die Sendung innerhalb der siebentägigen Lagerfrist nicht in der Filiale abgeholt.
entries.note: The same scan in German, on the same Paketda page.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde nicht abgeholt und wird zurückgesandt.
entries.note: Quoted on https://www.paketda.de/status-dhl-sendung-nicht-abgeholt.html: the return starts.

entries.wording: Die Sendung befindet sich auf dem Weg zurück zum Absender.
entries.note: Quoted on https://www.paketda.de/status-dhl-ruecksendung-eingeleitet.html: a return under way.

entries.wording: Aufgrund einer Beschädigung der Umverpackung wurde die Sendung von DHL nachverpackt und befindet sich jetzt auf dem Weg zum Absender.
entries.note: Repacked after damage to its outer packaging and sent back to the sender: the return under way.

entries.wording: Shipment returned - storage period exceeded.
entries.note: The return of a parcel left uncollected at a Packstation past its storage period: it started back.

entries.wording: The shipment will be delivered tomorrow
entries.note: Forecast: deliberately unmapped. It keeps the structured progress fallback rather than announcing delivery or pre-advice.
Structured completion flag; outranks the wording.
A completed return, not a delivery.
